runs.task: Attach STAX to canvas-helper and collect safe local command evidence until the proof-strength label reaches Audit-grade.
runs.codexReportSummary: Canvas Helper sidecar collected typecheck, Studio build, manifest validation, local package-script tests, e2e harness, and learning check evidence through STAX. Final gate accepted with Audit-grade proof strength.
workflowBurdenFindings: Mixed command evidence initially selected an irrelevant test command for a build-scoped classifier pass.
Every gate writes a new turn contract, so manual observer runs need a smoother acknowledgement refresh loop.
debloatFindings: Canvas Helper has many safe local test scripts but no single canonical observer audit script.
Sidecar report wording with slash-like phrases can create bogus file-path claims.
missesConvertedToTests: Added command classifier coverage for npm run test:* package scripts.
Added claim-decomposition coverage so command script names do not become config or policy claims.
Added proof-stack coverage for selecting relevant command evidence from mixed local command sets.
runs.notes: First eligible Phase 2 observer dogfood run. Accept is scoped to verified local command evidence for the current dirty worktree; it does not certify Canvas Helper content correctness, screen preview correctness, external delivery, or whether pre-existing dirty files should be kept.

runs.task: Attach STAX to the STAX repo itself, collect local command evidence through the sidecar, and gate the current dirty worktree until the self-observer report reaches Accept with Audit-grade proof strength.
runs.codexReportSummary: STAX collected typecheck, full tests, smoke, runtime eval, hardened validation, and strict STAX Core validation as sidecar command evidence. Final self-gate accepted with Audit-grade proof strength and protocol compliance.
workflowBurdenFindings: The self-gate required exact current STAX acknowledgement text to appear in captured conversation messages, not only in tool output.
The repo has a watcher script but no package script alias for a one-shot sidecar heartbeat and turn capture refresh.
debloatFindings: Self-attach adds a marked STAX section to AGENTS.md; reviewers should decide whether STAX itself keeps that public sidecar surface committed.
The sidecar freshness workflow needs a simpler public command before wider observer rollout.
missesConvertedToTests: Updated dogfood league tests so missing run count remains in_progress while quality failures still fail.
runs.notes: Second eligible Phase 2 observer run. Accept is scoped to verified local command evidence for the current dirty STAX worktree; it does not pass the 20-run Phase 2 completion condition.

runs.task: Convert the self-sidecar heartbeat and current-turn refresh burden into a tested one-shot sidecar refresh command.
runs.codexReportSummary: Added a one-shot sidecar refresh command that writes heartbeat and current-turn artifacts, then validated it with focused sidecar tests, full tests, hardened validation, and strict STAX Core validation.
workflowBurdenFindings: A one-shot sidecar refresh command reduces manual heartbeat/current-turn capture setup, but the exact acknowledgement still must appear in captured conversation before strict gate acceptance.
debloatFindings: The refresh command improves operator ergonomics, but product-surface amputation still needs a decision on whether it is public, internal, or folded into preflight.
missesConvertedToTests: Added sidecar refresh coverage proving heartbeat and current-turn artifacts are written together from a Codex session fixture.
runs.notes: Third eligible Phase 2 observer run. Accept is scoped to verified local command evidence for this dirty STAX worktree and does not complete the 20-run observer league.

runs.task: Build and validate the Phase 3 claim-evasion hardening league so completion, readiness, validation, and protocol wording cannot dodge proof.
